newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 19.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Tuesday:
WASHINGTON - The U.S. gun industry hopes to make a fortune importing millions surplus American military firarms that the Pentagon gave away or sold at a discount to U.S. allies during the Cold War.
WASHINGTON - Lockheed Martin Corp., the nation's largest defense contractor, said it will shut down eight facilities and eliminate about 1,600 jobs in an effort to streamline operations.

WASHINGTON - White House associate counsel Mark Fabiani spent 21 months in the White House flacking for the Clinton administration on some of its biggest public relations problems, including Whitewater, but he never did any legal work.
WASHINGTON - Company directors are now being targeted by shareholder groups frustrated by feeble stock prices.
